document.heading: Kiowa Tribe False Claims Act

history.narrative: Posted on Kiowa Tribe Website: September 26, 2025. Read into Record by: Cole DeLaune, District 4 at Legislative Regular Session CII-(102), October 11, 2025. Legislative Public Hearing XI-(11), November 07, 2025. Legislative Regular Session CIII-(103), November 08, 2025.

document.text: At a duly called Session of the Legislature of the Kiowa Tribe held this 8th_day of November 2025, the following Resolution and Law were adopted.

recital.text: the Legislature is vested with the authority to pass laws and resolutions pursuant to Article VI, Section 6(a) of the Constitution of the Kiowa Tribe; and,

the Legislature has enacted the "False Claims Act," which is designed to govern and regulate all funds and property belonging to the Kiowa Tribe. This legislation aims to ensure transparency and accountability in financial dealings.; and,

the Legislature has enacted the "False Claims Act" to safeguard the Kiowa Tribe's resources. This legislation ensures that no individual, including appointed, elected officials, and others, can unlawfully appropriate funds or property from the Tribe; and,

recital.conjunction: NOW THEREFORE IT BE IT RESOLVED;
recital.text: that the Legislature hereby enacts the attached law entitled, "Kiowa Tribe False Claims Act".

procedural-data.text: The foregoing Resolution KL-CY-2025-028 was duly voted upon by the Legislature on November 08, 2025, at a Legislative Regular Session CIII-(103), with a vote of (4) in favor and (0) opposed, (0) abstaining, and (3) absent, according to the authority vested in the Legislature by the Constitution of the Kiowa Tribe.

Co-Sponsors: Kyle Ataddlety, District 1; Michael Primus, District 2; Timothy Satepauhoodle, District 3; Cole DeLaune, District 4; Tiya Rosario, District 5; Ben Wolf, District 6; Warren Queton, District 7.

text.b: DELIVERY OF THE RESOLUTION AND LAW TO THE CHAIRMAN

procedural-data.text: Resolution No. KL-CY-2025-028 was presented to the Chairman of the Kiowa Tribe on the 17th day of November, 2025, pursuant to the Article VI, Section 8(a)(iv) of the Constitution of the Kiowa Tribe, and will become effective after signature by the Chairman or veto override by the Legislature, and as otherwise required by the Constitution.
